affected_campaign.next_gate_description: The unit-minor route to the localized row-module certificate does not close. The Dulmage-Mendelsohn decomposition of the 111-column unit matching has 60 components with a canonical largest irreducible block of size 15, and all 19 blocks of size at most three have non-unit determinants carrying ten new irreducible factors, none of them a source matrix diagonal entry, so source-determinant localization does not invert them. The route is not proved impossible -- every column has alternative unit rows -- but the size-15 block alone admits about 1.4e29 alternative matchings and no structural reason has emerged why a unit choice should exist. Phase A remains frozen at REACHABLE_VISIBILITY_OPEN_RESOURCE_LIMIT; Phase C is complete as a methods artifact. Reopening requires a new owner-approved tool/version and versioned budget. In Phase B, the bounded n<=5 continuum-dimension preflight is complete after correcting the source-calibration coefficient and adding independent d=2 and d=4 anchors. All 88 unlabeled relations, all 7980 relabelings, and all 399 lazy-walk transition rows pass their bounded checks. A large-N replacement design now removes unlabeled-level enumeration, factorial canonicalization, and automorphism enumeration from the proposed trajectory path by sampling naturally birth-labeled down-set precursors with exact rational weights. Its automorphism-orbit sum reproduces the frozen multiplicity by design, but exact down-set enumeration still has a worst-case 2^n boundary and n=60 reachability is not certified. An independent audit also found that the current height and width helpers enumerate 2^n vertex subsets; the production height path is therefore redesigned as an exact O(n^2) longest-path dynamic program, while exhaustive height, width, canonical identifiers, and automorphism records are forbidden on the large-N path. No approximate fallback is authorized without a mixing and bias certificate. Portable integer-ticket replay, independent implementations, supplied four-dimensional geometric controls separated from BDG action evaluation, a controls-only spectral-window freeze, seed-level statistical validation, and hard subprocess resource supervision are specified but not implemented. The next gate is owner approval of a versioned budget for a bounded sampler-and-observable equivalence and cost preflight; no trajectories may run before that approval. The global verdict remains FINAL_THEORY_OPEN and no continuum, dimension, Spin-2, or complete finite ON semantics lattice claim is made.
